what: How the processed records of the dev split divide. `tables` recounts each part from rejudging/per_record.csv.gz, which holds the dev-split records only, and checks the sums. These are identities of the stored verdict table, not new results. The totals were counted by the maintainer from the full per-record file of the source package, restricted to the dev split; the totals over both splits are the ones the accepted 2026-10 analysis records (rejudging/rejudging.json, coverage).
